newsitem.title: USA: US stocks seen listless in shortened holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: US stocks seen listless in shortened holiday trade.

text.p: U.S. stocks should open mixed Tuesday, with very light turnover and no major market moves expected in an abbreviated session before the Christmas holiday tomorrow.
The Dow Industrials rose five points to about 6489 on Monday in very thin trading, with many Wall Street players already away on vacation.
"We'll probably just be drifting up or down a little bit in very low volume. I expect more of yesterday," said Hildegard Zagorski, Prudential Securities market analyst.
